Class ClientHandlerSocket

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.net.socket.server.ClientHandlerSocket
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientHandlerSocketInterface
public class ClientHandlerSocket extends Object implements ClientHandlerSocketInterface
Handles communication with a single client over a socket connection. Listens for incoming ClientEvents and forwards them to the ServerController. Also sends ServerEvents to the client and manages connection closure.
